decision: No variant passes the pre-recorded encoding nonregression gates in every scene; restore source and app. Logical array-construction reduction alone is insufficient.

decision.rules: Per-scene four-run mean P50 and P95 no higher than baseline plus max(0.020 ms,3% of baseline). Reject a persistent slowdown beyond that same margin in at least three of four neighboring pairs. This is a practical measurement-noise allowance, not statistical proof.
decision.logicalCountBenefitRule: At least 25% fewer Object.entries logical result/pair arrays per measured submission in all six scenes, checked separately with counters, not heap sampling. No resident-byte or GC-pause claim.
decision.note: Practical noise allowance; no statistical equivalence or actual heap-byte/GC-pause claim.

counterRuns.instrumentation: Logical Object.entries result and entry-pair array counts; separate from timing runs, not sampled heap bytes.

limits: Counters measure Object.entries result/pair-array constructions, not total heap bytes, resident memory, or GC frequency.
Timing runs have no counters, CPU/heap sampling, native trace markers, concurrent task-owned build or test.
Display mode changed between matrices. Never pool their absolute timings.
Third matrix captures identical1920x1080@60Hz/AC state before and after every process.
Four runs per variant and practical noise gates do not establish statistical equivalence or universal regression.
No new Edge comparison, physical presentation latency or full runtime/CTS acceptance after the final rollback.
